biotools.summary: EXMO (Exercise Medicine Ontology) is a reference ontology for individualized exercise prescriptions, providing a structured vocabulary of physical activity, health status, and exercise prescription terms.  It aims to support personalized exercise recommendations and integrate with databases and recommendation systems.
